senses.gloss: , m. (<he>לגג</he>, v. <cite ref="L00183"><he>לוֹג</he></cite>, formed like <cite ref="S01814"><he>קָצִין</he></cite>)
bottle, a vessel smaller than כַּד and larger than כּוֹס.
units: T’bul Yom IV, 4 ל׳ … ומלאהו וכ׳ a lagin which requires sunset to be clean (v. טָבַל) and which was filled out of a cask containing tithes (intended for T’rumah); Erub. 36ᵃ; Y. ib. III, 21ᵇ bot. (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 5:10">Tosef. Ohol. V, 10</cite>; Ohol. V, 4; <cite ref="Chagigah 22b">Ḥag. 22ᵇ</cite> Ms. M. (ed. <he>לוגין</he>); <cite ref="Chagigah 26a:4">ib. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>ל׳ טמאין</he> (read <cite ref="I00529"><he>טמא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 5:1">Ab. Zar. V, 1</cite> <he>הניח … לְגִינוֹ וכ׳</he> the gentile put his wine bag on it.

<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 7:16">Tosef. Ter. VII, 16</cite> <he>ל׳ שהניחו</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>שהניחן</he>, corr. acc. all the suffixes in the sentence); a. e.—Pl. <he>לְגִינִים</he>, <he>לְגִינִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 30:4">Kel. XXX, 4</cite> <he>ל׳ גדולים</he> large flasks (of glass).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:7:3">Y. Ḥag. II, end, 78ᶜ</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:2">Kel. XVI, 2</cite> <he>בית הל׳</he> a case of wickerwork for flasks; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 5:13">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 13</cite> <he>בית הליגונין</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 6:8">Ib. VI, 8</cite> <he>בית הל׳ … של עץ</he> a wooden flask case.—
Bets. 15ᵇ הללו בעלי ל׳ these are people counting their wine by laginin (less rich than the בעלי כדין, but wealthier than the בעלי כוסות).—
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 161">Yalk. Sam. 161</cite> <he>שבלְגִינוֹת</he> (the water) in the bottles.

senses.gloss: also לְגִינָה f. a garden-bed requiring a lagin of seed.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 9:5">Ter. IX, 5</cite> <he>מאה לגינה</he> Ms. M. a. Y. ed. (Bab. a. Mish. ed. <cite ref="L00142"><he>לגנה</he></cite>) one hundred beds planted with T’rumah seeds; Tosef. ib. VIII, 4 <he>מאה לגין</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>לגינין</he>; R. S. to Ter. l. c. quotes <cite ref="L00183"><he>לוג</he></cite>); [v., however, <cite ref="L00141"><he>לִגְנָא</he></cite>].
